name: Hugh Lafast
source: The most notorious knight in all of Caerulia, Sir Hugh Lafast also serves as the Squire's mentor. He takes the protagonist under his wing for saving his life and promises to aid him in his quest of finding man's greatest pleasure. Sir High may be a slacker, but he's one of the best fighters in the kingdom.
